title: The Garden of Hidden Secrets
tagline: Four sealed gardens. Four seeds. One secret.

ui.noItems: Nothing yet. Look around the garden.
ui.noTruths: Nothing yet. Open a garden to read what Odalys left.
ui.holdHelp: Now tap the right spot in the room.
ui.needItem: You need something for this. Open the satchel.
ui.hintDone: Nothing left to solve here. Take the way out.

mission.heading: The Garden of Hidden Secrets
paras: Thistlewick Manor kept one door locked for ten years: the walled garden of Great-Aunt Odalys. She is gone now, and she left Wren the key.
You are Wren, and Osric, the gardener's grandson, is with you. Odalys hid a secret somewhere inside, behind four sealed gardens, each guarded by a seed.
Find the secret before the light fades. You have five minutes.

tutorial.text: Drag to look around the garden. Soft rings can be tapped.
Tap things to save them. Your journal holds the seeds you carry and every clue you find.
Each garden ends with one puzzle. Close it any time with the X. Blooms are your score: finds earn Blooms, wrong answers cost some.
You have 3 hints for the whole game, and each costs Blooms. Watch the clock: you have five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: odalys
dialogue.text: Wren, if you can hear this, the key found you. Four gardens, four seeds. Be gentle with what grows.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Her voice. Osric, she really did leave all of this for me.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Then let's not waste the light. Four gardens, four seeds, and one secret.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Look around again. Something here is hiding in plain sight.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: The ivy gate opened. Osric, that fountain is bone dry.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: It only wakes for the right amount of water. Look for her watering cans.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: A big can with a five painted on it. It holds five buckets.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: And a small one with a three. Two cans, two different sizes.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: 'Four buckets wake the fountain.' The rim shows the two sizes, three and five.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Pouring one can into the other leaves something behind. That's her trick.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: A tag on the gate says four seeds, four gardens. Let us start here.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Exactly four buckets! Listen, the fountain is waking up.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Odalys loved a puzzle that taught patience. I think the daisy was her first.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Fill the big can, then pour it into the small one. See what stays behind.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Empty the small can, pour the leftover across, refill the big can, then top up the small one.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Not quite. Think about pouring one can into the other.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Read the fountain rim again. Exactly four buckets. Not three, not five.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Fill the big can, pour into the small, empty the small, then pour the rest across.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: A glasshouse! Look at the orchids. They are wilting.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: They're thirsty. The rain barrel is full, but all the pipes are turned wrong.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: A pipe diagram. Rain must travel from the barrel to the orchid bed.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: The barrel is full of rain, but the water has nowhere to go.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: The bed is dry, but one orchid still holds a tiny bud.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Listen! The water is running down the clay pipes.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: She built this to keep her orchids alive all winter. She planned everything.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Start at the barrel. Which way must the first pipe face?

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: The rusted pipe can't turn, so the whole route must pass through it as it is.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: A leak! Every open end must meet another pipe.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Check the diagram. Water must travel from the barrel to the orchid bed.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Turn the pipes until no red glow is left, then open the tap.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: The statue lawn. The sun is low. We have not much light left.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: That statue is pointing at something. Odalys never did anything by accident.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Where he points, the dial answers. Then the chimney keeps a number.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: There's a tiny notch cut into the dial's blade. That works like a sight.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Finger, notch, chimney. We have to find the spot where they line up.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Got it! The number was painted right on the chimney.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: She hid it in plain sight. You only had to stand in the right place.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Slowly turn the view. Watch the three marks drift apart and come together.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Stop where one green line crosses the finger, the notch and the chimney.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: That isn't the number. Read the chimney again.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: The chimney only shows its number when the three marks line up.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Line them up first. Then copy the painted number onto the lock, digit by digit.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: The secret garden. It's even lovelier than I imagined.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: A raised bed, four kinds of seed, and it is only half planted.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Tulips! This must be Odalys's own seed. She saved it for the end.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: No flower twice in any row or column. That's her planting rule.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Four hollows in the door, shaped like seeds. The bed must be planted first.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Every flower in its place. The whole garden is humming.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: She wasn't hiding a treasure, Osric. She was hiding a home.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Start in the top row. An Orchid can't go in column three, one already grows there.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: The top row is Daisy, Orchid, Rose, Tulip. Now row two needs a Rose and an Orchid.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Something repeats. Check each row and column for a flower that grows twice.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Read the planting rhyme again. No flower twice in any line.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: The top row is forced first. Then work down, one column at a time.

dialogue.speaker: odalys
dialogue.text: Wren, you found all four. I never hid a treasure. I hid my favourite place in the world. What becomes of it is yours to choose.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: It was hers, Osric. And she asked us to keep it safe.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Then we'll keep it. And water the daisies every Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: It's too beautiful to hide. Odalys wanted it to grow.

dialogue.speaker: osric
dialogue.text: Wren... look at the door. There is another key hanging there.

can5.name: Big Watering Can
can5.text: Holds five buckets. A 5 is painted on its side.

can3.name: Small Watering Can
can3.text: Holds three buckets. A 3 is painted on its side.

daisy.name: Daisy Seed
daisy.text: The first seed. Daisies open for anyone patient enough to wait.

orchid.name: Orchid Seed
orchid.text: The hardest seed to keep alive. Odalys kept it through every winter.

rose.name: Rose Seed
rose.text: She planted roses where she could see the manor from the garden.

tulip.name: Odalys's Tulip Seed
tulip.text: Her own flower. She saved it for the very end.

truths: Odalys grew the Daisy first, because daisies open for anyone who is patient.
The Orchid was her hardest bloom. She watered it all winter through a glasshouse of clay pipes.
She planted her Roses where she could see the manor, so the house was always watched over.
Her own flower was the Tulip. The garden was never a secret. It was a gift waiting for the right Wren.

r1.help: Fill, pour and empty the cans until one holds exactly four buckets. Then pour it into the fountain.
r1.wrongText: Neither can holds exactly four buckets yet.

r2.title: Pipe Flow
r2.help: Tap a clay pipe to turn it. Water must flow from the barrel to the orchid bed. Every pipe on the board must be joined: no red glow anywhere, even on the loose pipes. The rusted pipe cannot turn.
r2.wrongText: The water leaks. Every pipe must join the next one.
r2.rules: No pipe may have an open end (red glow). The rusted pipe is stuck, so build the route around it.

r3.help: Turn the view until the statue's finger, the sundial notch and the far chimney all line up. Then read the chimney.
r3.lined: They line up. Read the number on the chimney.
r3.notYet: The chimney's number is hidden behind the ivy.
r3.wrongText: That is not the number painted on the chimney.

r4.help: Plant the bed. Each flower grows once in every row and every column. Tap a square to change its flower.
r4.wrongText: Some flower grows twice in a row or a column.

rooms.name: Ivy Gate and Fountain Court
rooms.objective: Wake the fountain: find two watering cans and measure exactly four buckets.
rooms.objectiveReady: Pour the water into the fountain.

reward.toast: The fountain wakes. A daisy seed rises from the water.

hotspots.label: Fountain rim
hotspots.title: The fountain rim
hotspots.text: Carved into the rim: 'Four buckets wake the fountain.' Two sizes are painted beside it, 3 and 5.

hotspots.label: Wheelbarrow tag
hotspots.title: Odalys's tag
hotspots.text: A tag tied to the barrow: 'Pour one can into the other. What stays behind is the answer.'

hotspots.label: Ivy gate
hotspots.title: The ivy gate
views:
The ivy gate
Iron, old and tangled in green.

A hanging tag
'Four seeds, four gardens.'
hotspots.secret: Hidden in the ironwork, a tiny daisy is carved into the latch.

rooms.name: The Glasshouse
rooms.objective: Bring rain from the barrel to the orchid bed.

reward.toast: The orchids lift their heads. An orchid seed drops into your palm.

hotspots.label: Pipe diagram
hotspots.title: Pipe diagram
hotspots.text: Odalys's sketch: rain runs from the barrel on the left, along clay pipes, to the orchid bed on the right. Every pipe must join the next. No open ends. One old pipe is rusted fixed, so build around it.

hotspots.label: Rain barrel
hotspots.title: The rain barrel
hotspots.text: The barrel is full of rain, but its tap is shut. A scratched note says: 'Water the orchids first.'

hotspots.label: Orchid bed
hotspots.title: The orchid bed
views:
The orchid bed
Dry soil and drooping leaves.

One bud
A single orchid still holds a tiny bud.
hotspots.secret: Under the leaves, a small clay tag: Odalys wrote that orchids forgive a late friend.

rooms.name: The Statue Lawn
rooms.objective: Find the spot where the statue's finger, the sundial and the chimney line up.

reward.toast: The roses open. A rose seed falls into your hand.

hotspots.label: Statue plinth
hotspots.title: The statue plinth
hotspots.text: On the plinth: 'Where I point, the dial answers. Where the dial answers, the chimney keeps a number.'

hotspots.label: Sundial
hotspots.title: The sundial
views:
The sundial
Worn bronze on a mossy pedestal.

The blade
A tiny notch is cut into the top of the blade.
hotspots.secret: Scratched on the dial's edge: 'Stand low and look along.'

hotspots.label: Rose arch tag
hotspots.title: The rose arch tag
hotspots.text: A tag on the arch: 'Finger, notch and chimney become one line. Only one place on the lawn shows it.'

rooms.name: The Secret Garden
rooms.objective: Plant the raised bed, then decide what becomes of the garden.

hotspots.label: Planting rhyme
hotspots.title: The planting rhyme
hotspots.text: On the bench: 'Four flowers, four rows, four columns. In every row and every column, no flower grows twice.'

hotspots.label: Arched door
hotspots.title: The arched door
hotspots.text: The door has four seed-shaped hollows. Seeds belong in the bed, not the door. Plant the bed first.

cinematic: The last flower goes in, and the four seeds sink into the soil. The whole garden holds its breath.

choose.prompt: What will Wren do with the garden?

options.label: Keep the garden hidden as Odalys wished
cinematic: Wren closes the gate gently. The ivy folds back, and Thistlewick keeps its quiet secret.
Some gardens bloom best when only a few know the way in.

win.title: The Garden Sleeps
win.text: You found the secret of Thistlewick and kept it safe, just as Odalys wished.

options.label: Open it to the village
cinematic: Wren swings the gate wide. By evening the whole village is walking among the roses.
On the inside of the old door, a second keyhole glints. Beside it hangs another key on a ribbon, tagged: 'The Orchard Gate.'

win.title: The Garden Opens
win.text: The village has a garden again. But the old door still holds one more key...

win.title: The Secret Is Found
win.text: Odalys left her garden to someone who would care for it.

timeup.title: The Garden Closes
timeup.text: The light fades. Petals fall, and the garden closes its gate again.
